Carlos Hurtado — Senior Engineer & Game Developer

VR game developer, Asgard's Wrath. Senior Engineer at Sneaky Devil Studios, previously Technical Lead Manager at Sanzaru Games (Oculus Studios, Meta). Shipping award-winning VR games since 2008, including Asgard's Wrath 2 (10/10, IGN). Based in San Mateo, California.
